description.value: Whole Foods Market Upper West Side is the big uptown grocery at 808 Columbus Ave, New York, NY 10025-5139, open Monday - Friday: 7 am - 10 pm and the same hours on weekends. The store page lists Kikka Sushi Highest quality fresh tuna, a Market Sandwich counter with Sandwiches made to order, a Whole Foods Wine Store and a Butcher’s Cut Room. An aggregated guest review (Exa listing) calls it A very large supermarket serving the Upper Westside, with very fully stocked shelves and slightly higher prices, and a Yelp highlight (search snapshot) says More groceries than the Columbus Circle Location. Ratings: Exa listing Rating 4.2 out of 5 · 2,920 reviews; Yelp search snapshot 3.2 (385 reviews). Representative aggregated guest reviews praise: “great fresh produce and good sales”. Representative watch-outs: “slightly higher prices”.
